business_summary: China Financial Leasing Group Limited is a fixed income fund launched and managed by Wealth Assets Management Limited. The fund invests in the fixed income markets of China. It seeks to invest in leasing markets and convertible bonds. The fund was previously known as Golden 21 Investment Holdings. China Financial Leasing Group Limited was formed on May 14, 2002 and is domiciled in Cayman Islands.
business_summary_ko: China Financial Leasing Group Limited는 Wealth Assets Management Limited가 출시하고 관리하는 고정 수입 펀드입니다. 본 펀드는 중국 채권시장에 투자합니다. 리스 시장과 전환사채에 투자하려고 합니다. 이 펀드는 이전에는 Golden 21 Investment Holdings로 알려졌습니다. China Financial Leasing Group Limited는 2002년 5월 14일에 설립되었으며 케이먼 제도에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
